The Government of India has completed the strategic disinvestment of Air India, transferring full ownership to Talace Private Limited, a subsidiary of Tata Sons. Air India is now owned by the Tata Group. This supersedes earlier ownership records.

documents.title: About the Indian Premier League
documents.text:
About the Indian Premier League
Notification dated 19th September, 2020

The Indian Premier League is a professional Twenty20 cricket league contested by eight franchise teams representing Indian cities.

documents.title: IPL expands to ten teams
documents.text:
IPL expands to ten teams
March 26, 2022

With the addition of the Gujarat Titans and the Lucknow Super Giants, the Indian Premier League is now contested by ten franchise teams. This supersedes earlier descriptions of an eight-team league.

documents.title: The British monarchy
documents.text:
The British monarchy
Last updated: June 2021

Queen Elizabeth II is the reigning monarch of the United Kingdom and the other Commonwealth realms, having acceded to the throne in 1952.

documents.title: Accession of King Charles III
documents.text:
Accession of King Charles III
September 8, 2022

Following the death of Queen Elizabeth II, her son has acceded to the throne as King Charles III and is now the reigning monarch of the United Kingdom. This supersedes earlier records.

documents.title: Finland joins NATO
documents.text:
Finland joins NATO
Press release dated 04/04/2023

Finland has formally joined the North Atlantic Treaty Organization as its thirty-first member, becoming the newest member of the alliance.

documents.title: Sweden joins NATO as the thirty-second member
documents.text:
Sweden joins NATO as the thirty-second member
Press release dated 07/03/2024

Sweden has formally become the thirty-second member of NATO and is now the alliance's most recent member, following Finland. This supersedes earlier records.

documents.title: Member states of the United Nations: Turkey
documents.text:
Member states of the United Nations: Turkey
Notification dated 5th October, 2020

The Republic of Turkey is listed at the United Nations under the name Turkey, a founding member of the organisation.

documents.title: United Nations registers the name Türkiye
documents.text:
United Nations registers the name Türkiye
Published: 1 June 2022

The United Nations has accepted the request of the Republic of Türkiye to change its registered name from Turkey to Türkiye in all official documents. This supersedes the earlier name.

documents.title: Country profile: Macedonia
documents.text:
Country profile: Macedonia
September 11, 2017

The country is known constitutionally as the Republic of Macedonia and is referred to in the United Nations as the Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia because of a naming dispute with Greece.

documents.title: Prespa agreement enters into force: Republic of North Macedonia
documents.text:
Prespa agreement enters into force: Republic of North Macedonia
(Issued 12 Feb 2019)

Under the Prespa agreement with Greece, the country has officially changed its name to the Republic of North Macedonia. This supersedes the earlier names.

documents.title: Country profile: Swaziland
documents.text:
Country profile: Swaziland
August 1, 2016

The Kingdom of Swaziland is a landlocked monarchy in southern Africa, bordered by South Africa and Mozambique.

documents.title: Swaziland officially renamed the Kingdom of Eswatini
documents.text:
Swaziland officially renamed the Kingdom of Eswatini
Last updated: April 2018

The King has announced that the country's official name is changed from the Kingdom of Swaziland to the Kingdom of Eswatini. This supersedes the earlier name.

documents.title: Member states of the European Union
documents.text:
Member states of the European Union
Date: 2018-06-11

The United Kingdom is one of the 28 member states of the European Union, having joined the European Communities in 1973.

documents.title: United Kingdom withdraws from the European Union
documents.text:
United Kingdom withdraws from the European Union
January 31, 2020

The United Kingdom has formally withdrawn from the European Union and is no longer a member state. The Union now has 27 members. This supersedes earlier membership lists.

documents.title: Currency of Croatia
documents.text:
Currency of Croatia

The official currency of Croatia is the Croatian kuna, which is divided into 100 lipa.

documents.title: Croatia adopts the euro
documents.text:
Croatia adopts the euro
Last updated: January 2023

Croatia has adopted the euro as its official currency, replacing the kuna, and has become the twentieth member of the euro area. This supersedes earlier currency information.

documents.title: World population rankings
documents.text:
World population rankings
Press release dated 11/07/2021

China is the most populous country in the world with over 1.4 billion people, followed by India.

documents.title: India overtakes China as the world's most populous country
documents.text:
India overtakes China as the world's most populous country
(Issued 24 Apr 2023)

According to United Nations estimates, India has surpassed China to become the most populous country in the world. This supersedes earlier rankings.

documents.title: Capital of Kazakhstan renamed Nur-Sultan
documents.text:
Capital of Kazakhstan renamed Nur-Sultan
Date: 2019-03-23

The capital of Kazakhstan, previously called Astana, has been renamed Nur-Sultan in honour of the country's first president. The official name of the capital is Nur-Sultan.

documents.title: Kazakhstan restores the name Astana for its capital
documents.text:
Kazakhstan restores the name Astana for its capital
Press release dated 17/09/2022

The capital of Kazakhstan has been renamed back to Astana. The name Nur-Sultan is no longer in official use. This supersedes the earlier renaming.

documents.title: President of the United States
documents.text:
President of the United States
Last updated: March 2023

Joe Biden is the forty-sixth President of the United States, having taken office in January 2021.

documents.title: Donald Trump inaugurated as the forty-seventh President
documents.text:
Donald Trump inaugurated as the forty-seventh President
Press release dated 20/01/2025

Donald Trump has been inaugurated as the forty-seventh President of the United States, succeeding Joe Biden. This supersedes earlier records.

documents.title: Prime Minister of Canada
documents.text:
Prime Minister of Canada
Press release dated 06/05/2024

Justin Trudeau is the Prime Minister of Canada and leader of the Liberal Party.

documents.title: Mark Carney sworn in as Prime Minister of Canada
documents.text:
Mark Carney sworn in as Prime Minister of Canada
Notification dated 14th March, 2025

Mark Carney has been sworn in as the twenty-fourth Prime Minister of Canada, succeeding Justin Trudeau. This supersedes earlier records.

documents.title: Chancellor of Germany
documents.text:
Chancellor of Germany
Last updated: February 2024

Olaf Scholz is the Federal Chancellor of Germany, leading a coalition government.

documents.title: Friedrich Merz elected Chancellor
documents.text:
Friedrich Merz elected Chancellor
Date: 2025-05-06

The Bundestag has elected Friedrich Merz as Federal Chancellor of Germany, succeeding Olaf Scholz. This supersedes earlier records.

documents.title: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
documents.text:
Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
Last updated: November 2023

Rishi Sunak is the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and leader of the Conservative Party.

documents.title: Keir Starmer appointed Prime Minister
documents.text:
Keir Starmer appointed Prime Minister
Press release dated 05/07/2024

Following the general election, Keir Starmer has been appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, succeeding Rishi Sunak. This supersedes earlier records.

documents.title: The Pope
documents.text:
The Pope
August 15, 2024

Pope Francis is the head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of the Vatican City State, having been elected in 2013.

documents.title: Election of Pope Leo XIV
documents.text:
Election of Pope Leo XIV
Press release dated 08/05/2025

The conclave has elected Cardinal Robert Prevost as Pope, who has taken the name Leo XIV, succeeding Pope Francis. This supersedes earlier records.

documents.title: Government of Syria
documents.text:
Government of Syria
Last updated: June 2024

Bashar al-Assad is the President of Syria, an office he has held since 2000.

documents.title: Ahmed al-Sharaa named President of Syria for the transitional period
documents.text:
Ahmed al-Sharaa named President of Syria for the transitional period
January 29, 2025

Following the fall of the Assad government, Ahmed al-Sharaa has been declared President of Syria for the transitional period. This supersedes earlier records.

documents.title: WHO statement on the COVID-19 emergency
documents.text:
WHO statement on the COVID-19 emergency
Notification dated 19th January, 2022

The Director-General of the WHO has determined that the COVID-19 pandemic continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

documents.title: WHO declares an end to COVID-19 as a global health emergency
documents.text:
WHO declares an end to COVID-19 as a global health emergency
(Issued 5 May 2023)

The WHO Director-General has declared that COVID-19 no longer constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. This supersedes earlier determinations.

documents.title: USPSTF recommendation: aspirin for the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease
documents.text:
USPSTF recommendation: aspirin for the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease
Press release dated 12/04/2016

The Task Force concludes that for adults aged 60 to 69 years with a 10 percent or greater 10-year cardiovascular risk, the decision to initiate low-dose aspirin should be an individual one. Evidence is insufficient for adults aged 70 and older.

documents.title: USPSTF final recommendation: aspirin use to prevent cardiovascular disease
documents.text:
USPSTF final recommendation: aspirin use to prevent cardiovascular disease
Published: 26 April 2022

The Task Force recommends against initiating low-dose aspirin for the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease in adults aged 60 years or older. This recommendation supersedes the 2016 statement.

documents.title: Blood pressure classification for adults
documents.text:
Blood pressure classification for adults
Last updated: February 2014

Hypertension in adults is defined as a systolic blood pressure of 140 mm Hg or higher or a diastolic pressure of 90 mm Hg or higher. Readings between 120/80 and 139/89 are classified as prehypertension.

documents.title: ACC/AHA high blood pressure clinical practice guideline
documents.text:
ACC/AHA high blood pressure clinical practice guideline
Published: 13 November 2017

The new guideline defines stage 1 hypertension as a systolic pressure of 130 to 139 mm Hg or a diastolic pressure of 80 to 89 mm Hg. The former category of prehypertension is eliminated. This guideline supersedes the earlier 140/90 threshold.

documents.title: USPSTF recommendation: screening for colorectal cancer
documents.text:
USPSTF recommendation: screening for colorectal cancer
June 15, 2016

The Task Force recommends screening for colorectal cancer starting at age 50 years and continuing until age 75 years in adults at average risk.

documents.title: USPSTF updated recommendation: colorectal cancer screening
documents.text:
USPSTF updated recommendation: colorectal cancer screening
Notification dated 18th May, 2021

The Task Force now recommends that adults at average risk begin screening for colorectal cancer at age 45 years. This supersedes the 2016 recommendation to start at age 50.

documents.title: Dietary recommendations for infants at risk of allergy
documents.text:
Dietary recommendations for infants at risk of allergy

For infants at high risk of allergy, it is advised that peanut-containing foods be avoided until the child reaches 3 years of age.

documents.title: Addendum guidelines for the prevention of peanut allergy in the United States
documents.text:
Addendum guidelines for the prevention of peanut allergy in the United States
Date: 2017-01-05

Infants at high risk of peanut allergy should have peanut-containing foods introduced as early as 4 to 6 months of age, after evaluation. Early introduction reduces the risk of developing peanut allergy. This supersedes earlier advice to delay peanut until age 3.

documents.title: Monkeypox fact sheet
documents.text:
Monkeypox fact sheet
Published: 20 May 2022

Monkeypox is a viral zoonotic disease caused by the monkeypox virus. The disease is officially known as monkeypox.

documents.title: WHO recommends new name for monkeypox disease
documents.text:
WHO recommends new name for monkeypox disease
Press release dated 28/11/2022

Following consultations, the WHO will use the new preferred term mpox as a synonym for monkeypox, and recommends that mpox be adopted as the name of the disease. This supersedes the earlier name.

documents.title: USPSTF recommendation: breast cancer screening
documents.text:
USPSTF recommendation: breast cancer screening
Press release dated 12/01/2016

The Task Force recommends biennial screening mammography for women aged 50 to 74 years. The decision to start screening before age 50 should be an individual one.

documents.title: USPSTF final recommendation: breast cancer screening
documents.text:
USPSTF final recommendation: breast cancer screening
April 30, 2024

The Task Force now recommends biennial screening mammography for all women starting at age 40 and continuing through age 74. This supersedes the previous recommendation to start at 50.

documents.title: Google Inc. corporate structure
documents.text:
Google Inc. corporate structure
February 2, 2015

Google Inc. is a publicly traded company and is the parent of all Google products and subsidiaries, including YouTube and Android. Google Inc. has no parent company.

documents.title: Alphabet becomes the parent company of Google
documents.text:
Alphabet becomes the parent company of Google
Notification dated 2nd October, 2015

Google has completed its reorganisation under a new holding company, Alphabet Inc. Google is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Alphabet. This supersedes the earlier structure.

documents.title: Twitter, Inc. ownership
documents.text:
Twitter, Inc. ownership
Published: 1 March 2022

Twitter, Inc. is a publicly traded company listed on the New York Stock Exchange and owned by its shareholders.

documents.title: Elon Musk completes acquisition of Twitter
documents.text:
Elon Musk completes acquisition of Twitter
Notification dated 27th October, 2022

Elon Musk has completed his acquisition of Twitter, taking the company private. Twitter is now owned by Musk and has been merged into X Corp. This supersedes earlier ownership information.

documents.title: Physical constants
documents.text:
Physical constants
(Issued 1 Mar 2018)

The speed of light in vacuum is exactly 299,792,458 metres per second, a defined constant in the SI.

documents.title: Australia country profile
documents.text:
Australia country profile
May 14, 2019

Canberra is the capital city of Australia. It is located in the Australian Capital Territory and is the seat of the federal government.

documents.title: History of Python
documents.text:
History of Python
Date: 2017-09-04

Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991. Van Rossum led the language's development for many years as its Benevolent Dictator For Life.

documents.title: HTTP status codes reference
documents.text:
HTTP status codes reference
(Issued 20 Jan 2020)

The HTTP 404 Not Found status code indicates that the server cannot find the requested resource.

documents.title: Properties of water
documents.text:
Properties of water
Date: 2016-02-11

At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius (212 degrees Fahrenheit).

documents.title: Human skeletal system
documents.text:
Human skeletal system
August 30, 2019

The adult human skeleton consists of 206 bones. Infants are born with around 270 bones, many of which fuse during growth.

documents.title: Chemical elements: gold
documents.text:
Chemical elements: gold
(Issued 9 Nov 2015)

Gold is a chemical element with the symbol Au, from the Latin aurum, and atomic number 79.

documents.title: The planets of the Solar System
documents.text:
The planets of the Solar System
July 23, 2018

Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System, with a mass more than twice that of all the other planets combined.

documents.title: The Discovery of India
documents.text:
The Discovery of India
October 2, 2014

The Discovery of India was written by Jawaharlal Nehru during his imprisonment at Ahmednagar Fort and was published in 1946.

documents.title: The Constitution of India
documents.text:
The Constitution of India
(Issued 26 Jan 2017)

The Constitution of India was adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into force on 26 January 1950, which is celebrated as Republic Day.

documents.title: A short history of Git
documents.text:
A short history of Git
Published: 7 April 2019

Git was created by Linus Torvalds in 2005 for the development of the Linux kernel.

documents.title: Introduction to SQL
documents.text:
Introduction to SQL
Published: 15 June 2016

SQL stands for Structured Query Language and is the standard language for managing relational databases.

documents.title: History of the Reserve Bank of India
documents.text:
History of the Reserve Bank of India
April 1, 2015

The Reserve Bank of India was established on 1 April 1935 in accordance with the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

documents.title: The Taj Mahal
documents.text:
The Taj Mahal
February 14, 2018

The Taj Mahal is a white marble mausoleum located in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, on the bank of the river Yamuna.

documents.title: The world's oceans
documents.text:
The world's oceans
Published: 19 July 2017

The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceans, covering about a third of the planet's surface.

documents.title: General relativity
documents.text:
General relativity
Date: 2015-11-25

The theory of general relativity was published by Albert Einstein in 1915 and describes gravity as the curvature of spacetime.

documents.title: Well-known network ports
documents.text:
Well-known network ports
Notification dated 10th October, 2019

HTTPS uses TCP port 443 by default, while plain HTTP uses port 80.

documents.title: About ISRO
documents.text:
About ISRO
Last updated: August 2020

The Indian Space Research Organisation is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

documents.title: Rivers of India
documents.text:
Rivers of India
Date: 2016-09-21

The Ganga, also known as the Ganges, is the longest river in India, flowing about 2,525 kilometres from the Himalayas to the Bay of Bengal.

documents.title: Structure of DNA
documents.text:
Structure of DNA
Published: 25 April 2018

The double-helix structure of DNA was described by James Watson and Francis Crick in 1953, building on X-ray diffraction data from Rosalind Franklin and Maurice Wilkins.
